final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec **low_area_control** was taken down the full ladder: L1 used all 400 evaluations via `run_dse` (architect refined twice then stopped), producing a 27-design feasible Pareto front dominated by iterative CORDIC configurations. L2 system simulation confirmed the top selection with DDS SFDR 79.9 dBc / SNR 69.9 dB and 15-cycle latency, leaving the selection unchanged. L3/L4 had no recorded rows for this exact configuration (fresh exhaustive RTL run too heavy for a live campaign; no recorded synthesis), and L5 back-annotation found no measured data and flagged no winner change, so no reexplore was needed. Finalized selection: `iterative:data_width=16,n_iter=12,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=trunc` — 257 LUTs+FFs (161 LUT / 96 FF), 10.1 accuracy bits, 13.2 MSPS throughput, max error 2^-10.14, comfortably meeting the ≥1 MSPS and ≤2^-10 error constraints while minimizing area.
